headline: Minimum Wage Recovery Policy Has Not Slowed Formal Employment in Mexico: Conasami
summary: Mexico's Conasami says the minimum wage recovery policy has not slowed formal employment. Wage discussions for 2027 have restarted, with proposals ranging from 4.8% to 15%.
why: Minimum wage levels in Mexico affect labor costs for employers across the economy, and the annual setting process shapes wage and inflation expectations.
original_headline: Política de recuperación del salario mínimo no ha frenado al empleo formal en México: Conasami
